'''Wilko Brenggar''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and member of the [[Happy Blasters]]. Completely insane, he was recruited into the Happy Blasters after he was found randomly shooting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel in a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. A murderer with hundreds of [[Death/Legends|deaths]] to his credit, Brenggar handled his guilt by believing in reincarnation. He believed that he had been an Imperial [[Captain/Legends|captain]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and a [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] in past lives.<ref name="Scout" />
